race.comment: JOURAMA (11) is overdue for a win and looks hard to beat. Ran on hard fresh to finish finish then pushed forward off a wide draw last time and gave a sight but just missed. Looks hard to beat again. STAR OF MACEDON (14) was unlucky not to get off the mark over the autumn. Has placed four out of four, finishing runner-up on debut this trip before two city placings, culminating in a placing in Listed grade over a mile at Flemington. Terrible draw but has Shinn and will be winding up strongly late. INTERROGATE (3) has placed 3/5 and placed only try fresh. Fitter for two trials and rates a leading player. SHE'S LOADED (7) has been racing pretty well in three runs this time in, placing the last two. Draws the fence and looks a genuine chance.
